liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin' Take # 1** (3 reviews): Lowell George sings alone on this take; Lowell's contribution makes this take worth keeping [4][9][13]
- **Serengetti** (1 review): Reviewer says this is an alternate version of France, mislabeled as Serengeti [13]
- **I Need A Miracal** (1 review): Lowell's contribution also makes this track a keeper [9]
- **Good Lovin' Take # 2** (1 review): Lowell adds backing vocals here, and also on I Need a Miracle [4]
- **Saint Of Circumstance** (1 review): Reviewer doubts it comes from these sessions, unless Brent had already joined the band [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Good Lovin' Take # 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Serengetti**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Stagger Lee Take # 1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Stagger Lee Take # 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **If I Had The World To Give**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 5 archived performances [14]
- **I Need A Miracal**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- **Good Lovin' Take # 2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [14]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Saint Of Circumstance [14]

## The recordings

- **gd78-08-XX.sbd.wiley.11692.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 44 min; rated 3.62/5 by 13 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer rates the sound quality as average [5]

## Around the show

- Lowell died soon after the album, so reviewer imagines further collaborations that might have shaped the band's 1980s sound [10]
- Another circulating copy of these outtakes has the France track with alternate lyrics, but it sounds less crisp than this one [3]
- Several tracks sound close to the Shakedown Street album versions, like basic tracks without most of the overdubs [4]
- Lowell's presence is stronger here than on the finished album [5]
- Reviewer thinks this take beats the version that ended up on the released album [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-08-XX.sbd.wiley.11692.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard to MR, then unknown step, DAT, CDR, EAC secure extraction, WAV, seekable SHN; transferred by Tim Wiley from Paul Bottiglio's discs [1]
